query:
select current_timestamp as captured_at_utc,
 current_user as execution_role,
 pg_has_role(current_user, 'supabase_admin', 'MEMBER') as may_manage_supabase_admin_defaults,
 (select rolsuper from pg_roles where rolname = current_user) as execution_role_superuser,
 coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',coalesce(r.rolname,'ALL'),'database',case when s.setdatabase=0 then 'ALL' else 'CURRENT_DATABASE' end,'setting_name',split_part(v,'=',1),'configured',true)) from pg_db_role_setting s left join pg_roles r on r.oid=s.setrole cross join lateral unnest(s.setconfig) v where (s.setdatabase=0 or s.setdatabase=(select oid from pg_database where datname=current_database())) and (s.setrole=0 or r.rolname='authenticator') and split_part(v,'=',1) in ('pgrst.db_pre_request','pgrst.db_schemas')), '[]'::jsonb) as postgrest_role_database_setting_presence;
